purpose: Generic vocabulary exempt from the leak scan (gis check-literals, alias check-poi-literals): the POI values of #124 and the class (b) non-POI literals of #129 (docs/gis/rights/non-poi-literals.md). A term here is exempt only as a substring of our own prose. For POI values and class (b) literals alike, a whole JSON string value or key equal to a term is still a leak, except the values listed in `structural_values` (our own enum values) and, for POI values, the credited MLIT specification labels (class (a), Owner decision (ii)). Every term has its reason in `justifications`, every structural value in `structural_justifications`; add a term only after confirming it is a common word or schema fragment, never to hide a leaked value.

justifications.MB2F: Level name of the S03 drawing set (B5F...4F, M1F, MB2F) that our gaps, research and HANDOFF prose cite as a layer name; a level code, not descriptive wording.
justifications.Stream: Fragment of the word 'Streams' in HANDOFF prose (Streams downloads into a content-addressed store); a POI source also has the value Stream. Exempt only as a substring of prose.
justifications.above: Ordinary English word in our own notes (above/below ground, bounds) and a POI value in one source; exempt only as a substring of prose.
justifications.ange: Three-letter fragment of ordinary words such as range and change that occur in most of our prose and JSON text; as a POI value it is a fragment of a longer string, so the scan would flag every file.
justifications.below: Ordinary English word in our own notes (below ground, below threshold) and a POI value in one source; exempt only as a substring of prose.
justifications.building: Schema word used throughout our own reports (building, bldg feature kind, building height) and a POI category value; exempt only as a substring of prose.
justifications.door: Feature-kind word of our own CityGML reports (Door objects, bldg:Door semantic presence rows) and a value in a POI source; exempt only as a substring of prose.
justifications.elevator: Feature-kind word of our own network and gap reports (elevator presence) and a value in a POI source; exempt only as a substring of prose.
justifications.entrance: Ordinary English word in our own gap and research prose (station entrance) and a value in a POI source; exempt only as a substring of prose.
justifications.escalator: Feature-kind word of our own network and gap reports (escalator presence) and a value in a POI source; exempt only as a substring of prose.
justifications.exception: Ordinary English word. It occurs inside our own evidence ids (plateau-related-provenance#ksj-exception-heading) in gaps and rights text; it is also a PLATEAU codelist description. Exempt only as a substring of prose; a whole JSON value or key equal to it is still a leak.

justifications.公園: Ordinary Japanese noun in our own prose and report keys (公園名 is a POI attribute name, park references in notes); a one-word PLATEAU codelist description that carries no source-specific wording. Exempt only as a substring of prose.
justifications.地下通路: Common noun for an underground passage. It is part of the class (a) PLATEAU group name kept in the inventories (gml:name 池袋駅_B1地下通路), so it must survive inside that name, and it occurs in our own HANDOFF and gap prose; it is also an MLIT route-structure label. Exempt only as a substring of prose; a whole JSON value or key equal to it is still a leak.
justifications.島: Single kanji that is part of place names in our own prose (豊島区, the ward whose data we cite) and a one-character PLATEAU codelist description; generic geography, not source wording. Exempt only as a substring of prose.
justifications.道路: Ordinary Japanese noun in our own prose (道路, the road geometry decisions) and report keys (道路種別); a one-word PLATEAU codelist description that carries no source-specific wording. Exempt only as a substring of prose.
justifications.鉄道: Common noun (railway) inside the recorded KSJ attribution text 国土数値情報（鉄道・2024年） that rights/ reports quote, and in our theme names; it is also an MLIT specification label. Exempt only as a substring of prose; a whole JSON value or key equal to it is still a leak.
justifications.東京地下鉄: Publisher name (Tokyo Metro Co., Ltd.) that provenance and credit must record: the facts-only source tokyometro-ikebukuro-yardmap-2026-03 (decisions/facts-only-credit-wording.md, #122/#138) is published by it. It coincides with an operator value in the PLATEAU related layers, but naming a source's publisher is attribution, not reuse of a field value. Exempt only as a substring of prose; a whole JSON value or key equal to it is still a leak.
justifications.通路: Ordinary Japanese noun (passage) inside station facility names that our own pois.json records as facts (ticket-gate names such as a 中央通路 gate, decisions/facts-only-credit-wording.md, #122/#138) and in 地下通路; a one-word PLATEAU codelist description that carries no source-specific wording. Exempt only as a substring of prose; a whole JSON value or key equal to it is still a leak.

structural_justifications.road: Our own context reports emit kind "road" (PLATEAU tran layer) as an enum value, and counts keyed by it; that is GTEki schema vocabulary, not a copied label. A genuine source label equal to it would be an English word without wording value.
structural_justifications.unknown: The status marker "unknown" is our own enum value in rights, acquisitions, overlap and gap JSON (commercial_use, bbox_axis_order, license_name...). A copied codelist description 'unknown' carries no wording value, so excluding it whole-value would only produce false positives on our own markers.
structural_justifications.building: Our own enum value: the feature kind / facility-presence key that GTEki's network, gap, context and summary reports emit (and counts keyed by it). That is GTEki schema vocabulary, not a copied POI label; a POI value equal to this English word carries no wording value.
